flagged.title: Family & Loss
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly teaches that 'Nettles' is written in unrhymed blank verse (it rhymes ABAB CDCD EFEF GHGH) and quotes non-existent lines/phrases ('tall as soldiers', 'offering him a chair', 'would not let us see') that would penalise students in GCSE examinations.

mark_affecting.quote: The poem is written in blank verse, so unrhymed iambic pentameter
would not show us, would not let us see

mark_affecting.quote: In 2012, the Scottish poet Jen Hatfield wrote Love's Dog
